name: Neukaps LinkedIn Auto Connect
tagline: LinkedIn automation with connect, bulk messaging, and email/phone scraping.
description: Automate your LinkedIn growth with a single click. Neukaps LinkedIn Auto Connect is built to scale your networking and outreach efficiently while mimicking human behavior to reduce risk.
Set your desired connection count (1–100), click Start, and let the tool handle everything — from sending connection requests to messaging prospects automatically with smart delays.
Designed for recruiters, sales professionals, founders, and growth-focused individuals looking to maximize reach with minimal effort.
features: Automated connection requests — find and connect with relevant profiles effortlessly
Bulk message sender — deliver personalized messages at scale in a structured sequence
Email & phone number scraping — extract contact details from posts and profiles for lead generation
Export scraped data as DOC, JSON, or CSV
Expandable sidebar UI with multiple themes for a smooth workflow
Smart delays that mimic human behavior to reduce account risk

name: Jotly — Sticky Notes for Any Page
tagline: Pin sticky notes to any webpage. They persist per-site and reappear when you return.
description: Jotly turns any webpage into your personal notepad. Pin sticky notes directly onto the pages you visit — a reminder on an article, a to-do on your dashboard, a question next to a tricky paragraph — and they'll be waiting for you exactly where you left them the next time you return.
No account, no cloud, no tracking. Every note lives entirely on your device.
features: Notes saved per-site and restored automatically on return visits
Zero setup — no account, no sign-up, install and start jotting in seconds
Completely private — no backend, no cloud, nothing ever leaves your device
Works everywhere: news sites, docs, dashboards, research pages, and web apps
Notes stay out of the way when you don't need them

name: Markly — Highlight & Save Any Page
tagline: Highlight text on any page. Your marks come back when you return, all searchable in one panel.
description: Markly turns any web page into something you can mark up — and actually find again. Select a sentence, pick a colour, and it's saved. Come back tomorrow, next week or next month and your highlights are exactly where you left them.
No account, no sync service, no sign-up — everything lives in your own browser.

Markly doesn't remember where on the page you highlighted — it remembers the words. So when a site restyles, re-renders, or loads content in a different order, your highlights still land on the right sentence.
features: Five highlight colours, plus fill, underline, or strikethrough styles
Attach notes to any highlight — searchable alongside the quote
One side panel for a page's highlights or everything you've ever marked, grouped by page
Highlight via toolbar, right-click menu, or Alt+Shift+H
Highlights survive page restyles, re-renders, and reordered content
Export everything as Markdown or as a restorable JSON backup
Dark-site aware, works with infinite scroll and single-page apps

name: Tabby — Tab Manager & Memory Saver
tagline: Close duplicate tabs, search across every window, and auto-suspend idle tabs to save memory.
description: Tabby is a fast, private tab manager and memory saver — built to replace the heavy, over-permissioned suspenders of the past.

Too many tabs slowing your browser to a crawl? Tabby frees memory using Chrome's built-in tab-discard engine, so inactive tabs stop hogging RAM but stay right where you left them. Click one and it reloads instantly.
Only three permissions are required: tabs, storage, and alarms — no content scripts, no access to page content or browsing data.
features: Close duplicate tabs in one click, or automatically as they open
Search every open tab by title or URL across all windows
Auto-suspend idle tabs with a configurable threshold (default 30 minutes)
Smart exceptions for the active tab, pinned tabs, and tabs playing audio
Personal allowlist for sites that should never be suspended
Optional tab-count badge
Settings sync across your own Chrome profiles

name: Yonder — Currency, Unit, Time Zone & Translation
tagline: Highlight any price, measurement, time, or foreign text to convert or translate it instantly.
description: Ever hit a price in the wrong currency, a distance in the wrong units, or a meeting time in the wrong zone — and had to stop and open a converter? Yonder does it in place.
Highlight any price, measurement, or time on any web page and Yonder pops a tiny card with the converted value — in your currency, your unit system, and your time zone. Click any result to copy it.
The content of the pages you visit is never read or transmitted — Yonder only looks at the text you select, and only to convert it.
features: 150+ currencies with live daily exchange rates, plus an offline bundled rate snapshot
Time zone conversion with DST awareness and custom cities
Length, weight, temperature, speed, and volume conversion (metric ⇄ imperial)
Smart parsing of symbols, ISO codes, decimal conventions, and magnitude suffixes ($1.5k, 2M)
Fully translated interface in 13 languages, including RTL support for Arabic
Vanilla JavaScript with no frameworks or build step

name: Duosub — Dual Subtitles for YouTube
tagline: Two YouTube subtitle lines at once — the original and yours — with click-to-look-up words.
description: Turn every YouTube video into a language lesson. Duosub shows two subtitle lines at the same time — the original language you're learning on top, and your own language below — perfectly synced over the player.
When a word trips you up, just click it to look it up. No pausing to open a dictionary, no switching tabs, no losing your place.
Duosub reads the captions YouTube already provides and does everything in your browser — not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
features: Two synced subtitle lines with configurable order and text size
Click any word — including individually clickable Chinese/Japanese characters — for an instant look-up
Hover-to-pause: the video waits while you read a subtitle line
38 caption languages powered by YouTube's own caption translation
Interface available in 13 languages
Single storage permission — no account, no analytics, no servers

name: Current Affairs 2026 — GK World
tagline: An educational companion for India GK and current affairs, built for school students.
description: GK World is the ultimate educational app designed to empower school students with a wealth of knowledge about India GK and beyond. In a world where information is key, GK World serves as your invaluable guide, unlocking doors to academic excellence and a deeper understanding of India and the world.

The app is crafted to complement your school curriculum — a personal study companion aligned with your academic needs — while also covering India's history, culture, and geography, and offering a broader global perspective on international affairs.
Slogan: "Unlocking Wisdom, One Question at a Time."
features: Curriculum-aligned academic content for school students
Deep dives into India's history, culture, geography, and heritage
Global perspective: international geography, influential figures, and world issues
Designed to build daily knowledge habits and exam readiness

name: Smart Vault — Document Vault
tagline: A fast, 100% offline document manager. Scan, organize, search, and protect — everything stays on-device.
description: Smart Vault is a fast, private, 100% offline document manager. Scan, organize, search, and protect your important documents — everything stays on your device. No account, no cloud, no analytics.
Your Aadhaar, PAN, passport, licence, bills, and receipts never leave your phone.
Text inside your documents is read using on-device OCR via Google ML Kit, so images never leave the device while everything stays instantly searchable.
features: Document scanner with automatic edge detection and cropping
On-device OCR (Google ML Kit) for instant full-text search
Smart auto-categorization: Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Licence, Receipts, Insurance, and more
Full-text search across titles, notes, and scanned text
App lock with PIN and optional fingerprint/biometric unlock
Favorites, archiving, and personal notes on any document
Export to PDF and share directly from the app
Clean Material Design interface with light and dark modes

name: Streaky — Daily Habit & Study Tracker
tagline: Log study sessions, build daily streaks, and stay laser-focused until exam day.
description: Streaky (StudyLog) is your personal study tracker and exam prep companion. Stay consistent, beat procrastination, and watch your progress add up.

Whether you're preparing for JEE, NEET, boards, university finals, or any competitive exam, Streaky turns your daily effort into clear, motivating insights — hours studied, accuracy, streaks, and a countdown to exam day.
Your progress stays with you across sessions so you never lose your streak.
features: Log study sessions by subject and chapter — hours, questions attempted, and accuracy
Daily and best streak tracking to keep you consistent
Daily study-hour goals with a progress bar
Exam countdown right on your home screen
Visual consistency heatmap across the month
Subject-wise breakdown and accuracy insights
Habit tracking beyond study hours: revision, mock tests, sleep, and more
Monthly reports summarizing hours, questions solved, and goal hits
Light and dark mode
